sourceTitle: Why Foster with us? (Wakefield Council fostering)
feesNote: Wakefield pays a weekly skill-based payment for each child on top of the age-based allowance, at one of four levels.
extras: A £500 welcome bonus after three months with a child in placement
A £500 reward after the first 12 months with a short or long-term placement
From April 2026, a £500 loyalty payment each year for carers who have offered placements for 48 weeks or more
Holiday and birthday allowances (amounts not published)
summary: Wakefield pays a weekly allowance for each child, set by age, plus a weekly skill-based payment at one of four levels. New carers can receive up to £1,500 in bonuses and loyalty payments in their first year. The council's page does not state which year the rates are for; they are shown here as 2026-27, and are at or above the government's minimum allowances for April 2026 to March 2027.
